sheets.title: COVER SHEET – DESIGN INTENT DRAWINGS
sheets.reading_notes: Pre-design intent drawing package (6 sheets: G0.00 Cover, G0.01 Area Plan, SK0.01 Demo Layout, SK0.02 Proposed Layout, SK0.03 Equipment Layout, SK0.04 Elevations). Room 9N104 shown as 211 SF single-module room in B-Wing 9th floor. Project manager: C. Sheehy. Submission date: 06.24.2020. Drawing index confirms same WR# C109043.

sheets.title: DEMOLITION LAYOUT
sheets.reading_notes: Demolition keynotes: (1) window already removed by NIH DEP; (2) modify existing wall to accommodate new door location; (3) remove existing door. Scale 1/4"=1'-0". Room shell is approximately 14'x15' (estimated from scale).

sheets.title: PROPOSED LAYOUT
sheets.reading_notes: Proposed layout showing: lab benches along three walls (south, east, west), new 42" half-light door at north wall, new window (north wall), 19" ledge under window with black phenolic top, grommet hole for UC outlet, bench-mount compressed air/vacuum turrets (2 locations), 24" flammable storage cabinet, splash guards (3 locations), adjustable height bench areas. Scale 1/4"=1'-0".

sheets.title: EQUIPMENT LAYOUT
sheets.reading_notes: Government-furnished equipment layout: (1) Thermo undercounter freezer (x2), (2) Panasonic undercounter fridge (x2), (3) Thermal cycler, (4) Reciprocating shaker, (5) Micro centrifuge (x2). Equipment is owner-furnished/installed.

sheets.title: ELEVATIONS (EAST & WEST)
sheets.reading_notes: East elevation (4'-0" / 2'-6" / 3'-0" / 2'-0" / 2'-6" / 2'-0" / 4'-0" widths): shows Thermo UC Freezer, Micro Centrifuge, Thermal Cycler, Panasonic UC Fridge, Flam cabinet arrangement. West elevation: Shaker, Micro Centrifuge, Panasonic UC Fridge, Thermo UC Freezer arrangement. Bench heights indicated.
